verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Disputes API ('Process Disputes'), a webhooks system, and an official MCP server, so an agent could plausibly query disputes programmatically. The pack gives only page titles, with no detail on deadline fields, dispute webhook events, or evidence upload and submission endpoints. missing for 10: documented dispute deadline (due_at) fields, dispute-specific webhook event types, evidence creation/submission API details, a draft-for-review workflow, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor dispute deadlines via API or webhooks and draft evidence responses for my review

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://developer.squareup.com/docs/mcp
